problem.title: The Problem
problem.description: Today's social platforms reward {{highlight}} . Algorithms amplify conflict because angry engagement drives clicks. The result? We've forgotten how to disagree constructively with people who think differently.
problem.engagementDesc: Rewards anger, division, and echo chambers

state.title: STATE
state.description: Share your perspective on the question. Your opinion becomes a node on the graph.

chat.title: CHAT
chat.description: Connect with people who think differently. Request conversations with other nodes.

rate.title: RATE
rate.description: Evaluate your conversation partner on empathy and disagreement to calculate bridging scores.

bridgingScore.title: The Bridging Score
bridgingScore.explanation: {{empathy}} ranges from -50 to +50. {{disagreement}} ranges from 0 to 100. Your score ranges from {{minScore}} to {{maxScore}}.

green.name: Green Zone
green.meaning: High empathy + High disagreement = True bridging. You understood someone you deeply disagree with.

orange.name: Orange Zone
orange.meaning: Moderate bridging potential. Good conversation, but room to grow in empathy or find deeper disagreement.

red.name: Red Zone
red.meaning: Negative empathy indicates harmful interaction. The conversation wasn't constructive.

circles.title: Concentric Circles
circles.description: The graph displays three rings representing bridging score zones. The closer to the center, the higher the bridging score.

nodes.title: Nodes & Edges
nodes.description: Each node is an opinion. Lines connecting nodes represent conversations. Thicker lines indicate deeper engagement.

top5.title: Top 5 Bridgers
top5.description: The five highest-scoring bridgers appear in the green center zone with special prominence.

position.title: Your Position
position.description: Your node is highlighted. Click other nodes to request conversations or view existing chats.

anonymous.title: Anonymous Identity
anonymous.description: Passphrase-based login with no email or phone required. Your identity stays private.

ai.title: AI Conciliation (Planned)
ai.description: AI mediator available to help de-escalate heated discussions and find common ground.

legal.title: Criminal Prosecution
legal.description: No biased community guidelines. Reported content that might break the law is hidden, and pressing charges is supported.

cta.title: Ready to bridge the divide?
cta.description: Join the conversation and discover what happens when empathy meets disagreement.
